# IR-48 baseline: a Rust file over 1000 lines that has to stay over for a
# while. Each line is `<lines> <path>`, and the file may shrink but never grow.
#
# Every entry below is upstream's `srt-win` source, copied byte for byte into
# `crates/crabpot-windows/srt-win/` in #144 (ADR-0005, ADR-0001's baseline
# commit). crabpot does not rewrite upstream's Windows security code into
# smaller files: a later sync from upstream is a copy, and splitting these
# files locally would turn every sync into a merge. They leave the baseline when
# the Windows map rewrites a file, or upstream splits it first.
#
# `acl.rs` and `cli.rs` grew by the metadata grant, the first change to
# upstream's behaviour (`crates/crabpot-windows/PATCHES.md`, ADR-0016).
3996 crates/crabpot-windows/srt-win/src/cli.rs
3887 crates/crabpot-windows/srt-win/src/profile.rs
3287 crates/crabpot-windows/srt-win/src/profile_plan.rs
3141 crates/crabpot-windows/srt-win/src/acl.rs
2783 crates/crabpot-windows/srt-win/src/state_db.rs
2012 crates/crabpot-windows/srt-win/src/persist.rs
1335 crates/crabpot-windows/srt-win/src/probe.rs
1224 crates/crabpot-windows/srt-win/src/wfp.rs
1036 crates/crabpot-windows/srt-win/src/logon.rs
